text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 6 years of experience turning raw data into useful insight and practical business decisions. I’m excited to apply for your Data Analyst role because the work closely matches how I approach data: interpret it carefully, look for meaningful patterns, and turn findings into clear actions that support better decisions.

My background includes Python, pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, NLP, machine learning, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, and the OpenAI API. I’m comfortable working with data analysis workflows, building and maintaining data-driven systems, and identifying trends in complex datasets. I also value accuracy, consistency, and clear reporting, which are essential when working with databases, data collection systems, and ongoing analysis.

One project I can share is a support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co. in the SaaS space. I built a classifier in Python and scikit-learn that routed incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues, with the model served through FastAPI. I also set up nightly retraining through a Celery worker on Redis. The result was a macro-F1 score of 0.88 compared with 0.62 for the old keyword rules, and median routing time dropped from 6 hours to 4 minutes. That project strengthened my ability to work with structured data, improve process efficiency, and deliver measurable outcomes from analytics and automation.

I would bring that same analytical mindset to your team by helping interpret data, maintain reliable data systems, and surface trends that support business goals. I’m especially interested in roles where quality, responsibility, and practical insight matter, because I take pride in producing work that is both technically sound and useful to decision-makers.

I’d welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience and skills can support your data analysis needs.
